description: This file defines the UnifiedMemoryManager class in Apache Spark, responsible for managing shared memory between execution and storage, including tracking unmanaged memory components, and handling memory allocation and eviction policies.

classes.name: UnifiedMemoryManager
classes.description: Manages unified memory for Spark, handling memory allocation for execution and storage, tracking unmanaged memory, and coordinating eviction policies.

methods.name: getUnmanagedMemoryUsed
methods.description: Returns total unmanaged memory usage in bytes, combining on-heap and off-heap.

methods.name: registerUnmanagedMemoryConsumer
methods.description: Registers a component that manages its own unmanaged memory for periodic polling and tracking.

methods.name: unregisterUnmanagedMemoryConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered unmanaged memory consumer.

methods.name: getMemoryByComponentType
methods.description: Calculates total unmanaged memory used by components of a specific type.

methods.name: clearUnmanagedMemoryUsers
methods.description: Clears all unmanaged memory consumers and resets cached memory usage values.

methods.name: startPollingIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts a background thread to periodically poll unmanaged memory consumers, ensuring only one thread runs per JVM.

methods.name: shutdownUnmanagedMemoryPoller
methods.description: Shuts down the unmanaged memory polling thread, used mainly in tests.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a new UnifiedMemoryManager instance with configuration-based parameters.

methods.name: getMaxMemory
methods.description: Calculates the maximum shared memory available based on Spark configuration and system memory.
